seo.pageTitle: Carry the Culture — Hip Hop Diaper Bag
seo.metaDescription: A graffiti-canvas diaper bag backpack with fifteen pockets, three insulated bottle holders and a USB pass-through. Because of the print, no two are cut the same. Built in Los Angeles by Physics of Hiphop.

hero.lede: Not your generic baby gear. Fifteen pockets, three of them insulated, a USB pass-through and stroller straps — wrapped in a graffiti canvas that runs off the edge of every panel, so no two bags are cut the same.
hero.orbitAltText: The Hip Hop Diaper Bag, rotating. Drag to turn it.

rows.value: Printed canvas, tan leather, nickel hardware

pullQuote.quote: Dads often complain about carrying a diaper bag that looks like a diaper bag. Moms complain that doctor bags don't have enough style.

image.alt: A father wearing the bag in a gallery, a stroller behind him.
image.caption: Worn, not styled. Los Angeles.

image.alt: The bag with its insulated bottle sleeve, two stroller straps and USB cable.

items: Three insulated bottle holders, inside the main compartment.
Two side pockets, one of which dispenses wipes through a slot.
Two small slots for the things you lose — keys, a pacifier, a card.
One large front pocket under the snap flap.
Fifteen. Plus a top that opens wide enough to see the bottom.

image.alt: Someone wearing the bag on a rain-wet New Orleans street.

rain.quote: Not only is it water resistant — tested in the New Orleans rain — it allows for a lot to be packed for the people on the go.

image.alt: A power bank inserted into the bag's USB pass-through pocket.

usb.quote: Good insulation for maintaining bottle temps, and it even comes with a port for you to charge your phone — you just need a portable battery charger, not included.

image.alt: Macro of the debossed tan leather crown patch on the graffiti canvas.

crown.attribution: The mark, debossed into tan leather

image.alt: The bag on sand, close on the snap flap and leather tab.

sand.quote: It definitely serves as a catalyst for discussion anywhere I go.

founder.paragraph1: It was fascinating to me to go to a b-boy battle in Los Angeles and see all of the infants wearing colorful earmuffs being carried around by their parents. The next thought was — look at all of the amazing fathers hiphop has nurtured.
founder.paragraph2: But where are the specific tools for the hiphop parent? How are we as a culture celebrating this space where parenthood and hiphop meet? Hip Hop Diaper Bag is my answer.
founder.attribution: Marcus Gray / founder / Physics of Hiphop

cta.eyebrow: Available on Etsy / ships from Los Angeles
cta.note: 4.8★ across 51 ratings / includes changing pad, insulated bottle sleeve, two stroller straps and a USB cable

image.alt: A parent carrying a baby on one shoulder while wearing the bag.
